faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar (AIIMS Bhubaneswar) for an ICMR research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in AIIMS Bhubaneswar recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Project Technical Support-II under the Department of Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-II post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Graduate Degree in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, or Microbiology, along with two years of research experience in research projects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-II post is 30 years, with relaxations as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus 20% HRA as admissible per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 07-10-2026 up to 05.00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in-interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the walk-in-interview or video conferencing interview is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Bhubaneswar recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply by sending their filled-in application form and documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to this contractual project position.
